d:
Bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ke beti ki shadi samaroh men begusray ke arvind sinh ki maut ho gaee thi. mritak arvind sinh ke parijnon se mulakat karne aur sahyog karne ke lie aaj anant sinh ke donon bete abhishek kumar aur ankit kumar begusray jile ke sahebpur kamal thana kshetr ke rahuaa ganv pahunche.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
